title: Concept: Response body contains a token with an unsigned alg value
description: A JWT with alg none carries claims and no signature. A verifier that trusts the header therefore accepts whatever the caller sends, which turns a read-only token into a write primitive for any field in the payload.
applicability: Responses that issue, echo or debug tokens.
risk: The caller forges a token for any subject or role the application trusts, provided one verifier honours the header value.
